ul_announcer.instruct: 1930s American newsreel announcer, mid-Atlantic accent, very cheerful and theatrical, bright fast delivery, old radio showman, big smile in the voice.
ul_announcer.ref: Hello, boys and girls! Welcome back to another jolly picture show, brought to you in glorious sound!

ul_chorus.instruct: Many voices whispering in unison, eerie, breathy, slow and creepy, like a crowd of children and adults whispering together in a dark room.
ul_chorus.ref: We are all very happy here. We are always smiling. Always.

ul_tippy.instruct: Little cartoon kitten girl, high-pitched small child voice, terrified, trembling, about to cry.
ul_tippy.ref: Please, I don't want to play anymore. I want to go home.

lines.text: Welcome to Sunnyville, where everybody smiles!
And in Sunnyville, there's only one rule!
Oh dear. Someone in the audience... stopped smiling.
